name: Naked Nuras Loves Rave
summary: Core NLS production alias. Ambient, rave residue, analogue sequences, and serial Project AOA releases.
body: Naked Nuras Loves Rave is a primary artist vehicle on NLS Records — spanning ambient plates, free downloads, and the Project AOA series. The work treats production as an environmental practice: storm sessions, urban silence, and network-era loudness.

name: Jimmy Howe
summary: Music, prints, videos, and visual systems. Digital print series, A.Visualist drawings, and studio experiments.
body: Jimmy Howe works across sound and image — from experimental lo-fi tracks to Digital Prints Series A/ASCII and A.Visualist concepts. Visual music as a system of realization.

name: A.Visualist
summary: Drawings, concepts, Dimension7 paintings, and system diagrams for performance and print.
body: A.Visualist is the visual systems practice linked to NLS — drawings, concept plates, and Dimension7 work that sits beside the catalogue rather than illustrating it after the fact.

name: Matthias Kispert
summary: Cross-linked practice noted on the NLS artists network.
body: Matthias Kispert appears in the NLS archive network of artists and collaborators. Profile restored as a directory plate for the rebuild.
